meta.notes: Outpainting with the `fill-lightning-8` graph and one difference: the text encoder's reference (image1) is the picture alone, cropped out of the uploaded canvas by ImageCrop at {{ref_x}},{{ref_y}} {{ref_w}}×{{ref_h}} (the engine fills these), while the sampling latent is the whole padded canvas under the noise mask. Shown the padded canvas as its reference, the edit model reproduced the padding (replicated edges or grey) as content; shown the picture alone it paints beyond it.
